items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Nat Toles band had Henry Coker, the trombonist.

ctx.x: I met Baby Lovett there, he was playing at this club with -- I can't recall the name -- [Lee] Julia -- I can't recall her name, but she was famous, too and Baby Lovett was the greatest dresser, one guy I'll never forget because he always dressed -- light suits, light hat, beautiful shoes, he would stand in front of the poolroom there on the Cut, they called it the Cut, 18th and Vine.
